text: In a qualitative analysis of four randomly selected passages rated by two annotators on a 1-10 scale, the paper reports that arguments and counter-arguments supporting the correct answer are rated higher quality than those supporting the incorrect answer, while the average rating for all arguments is above 7/10.
title: Debate arguments and counter-arguments rated above 7/10; correct-side ones rated higher
